Welcome

A Welcome Letter from Jose Roca '84

Principal, Belen Jesuit Preparatory School

Dear Faculty and Staff,

Welcome back to Belen Jesuit, and welcome to a new school year! It is with great joy and anticipation that I greet each of you as we prepare to begin another year of forming Men for Others. Your dedication, talent, and faith are the heart of everything we do here, and I am deeply grateful for the gift each of you brings to our community.

This Welcome Back Week is designed to ground us in our mission, reconnect us as a community, and equip us with the tools and vision we'll need for the year ahead. I encourage you to approach these days with openness, collaboration, and the same spirit of Magis that has defined Belen for generations.

May this year be filled with growth, purpose, and the joy of accompanying our students on their journey. Thank you for all that you do — AMDG.

In Christ,
Jose Roca '84
Principal

Your countless hours of sacrifice, love, and support have meant the world to me. Honestly, Belen saved my life. If it wasn't for you all, I would've never found faith, discipline, or any of the core values that have been instilled in me… by some of the greatest mentors and teachers out there. I hope that you continue forming Men for Others, as you formed me and my brothers. I'm proud to be a part of this family, and would like to remind you that your vocation continues to bear fruit long after graduation.
